def VTask.evenOddRec : {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} → (h0 : P 0) → (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) → (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) → (n : ℕ) → P n :=
  fun {P} h0 h_even h_odd n =>
    let h : ℕ → P := fun n =>
      Nat.strongRecOn n fun n ih =>
        if h : n = 0 then
          -- Base case: n = 0
          h0
        else if h₁ : n % 2 = 0 then
          -- Even case: n = 2 * (n / 2)
          have h₂ : P (n / 2) := ih (n / 2) (by
            have h₃ : n / 2 < n := by
              have h₄ : n ≥ 1 := by
                omega
              have h₅ : n / 2 < n := by
                apply Nat.div_lt_self
                · omega
                · omega
              exact h₅
            omega
          )
          h_even (n / 2) h₂
        else
          -- Odd case: n = 2 * (n / 2) + 1
          have h₂ : P (n / 2) := ih (n / 2) (by
            have h₃ : n / 2 < n := by
              have h₄ : n ≥ 1 := by
                omega
              have h₅ : n / 2 < n := by
                apply Nat.div_lt_self
                · omega
                · omega
              exact h₅
            omega
          )
          h_odd (n / 2) h₂
    h n
